description.en: Refined Morandi palette — soft, painterly hues with a clean modern lift. Light and dark variants included.
description.zh: 精炼的莫兰迪色系——柔和如画的色彩,经过现代感的提亮调整,包含浅色和深色两种变体。

description.en: Frosted Nordic palette — cool blues, sage, and soft warm accents. Calm, modern, dev-friendly.
description.zh: 北欧霜色系——冷蓝、鼠尾草绿与柔和暖色点缀,沉静、现代,适合开发者。

description.en: Cherry-blossom palette — soft pinks, fresh leaf greens, and wisteria. Delicate and elegant.
description.zh: 樱花色系——柔粉、嫩叶绿与紫藤色,清丽典雅。

description.en: Botanical journal palette — mossy greens, bark, and autumn warmth on a paper-toned canvas.
description.zh: 植物图鉴色系——苔藓绿、树皮褐与秋日暖色,绘于纸感画布之上。

description.en: Playful pastel palette — macaron pinks, mints, peach, and buttercup. Bold but soft.
description.zh: 活泼的马卡龙色系——马卡龙粉、薄荷、桃色与奶油黄,明亮而柔和。
